name: lms-v2
description: LMS 2.0 — root dev orchestration (runs backend-py + frontend together)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r backend-py/requirements.txt
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend-py && python -m app.core.bootstrap_db && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.seed: cd backend-py && python -m scripts.seed && python -m scripts.seed_employees && python -m scripts.seed_demo
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend-py,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend-py && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
